answer_1.quote: We denote the AI-generated text detector weighted by w as D w : Y → [0, 1], where Y denotes the text domain. The detector D w maps text sequences y ∈ Y to corresponding LLM likelihood scores, where higher values indicate a greater probability of being LLM-generated.
answer_1.outputs: paraphrased paragraphs that aim to evade AI-text detection while preserving semantic meaning

answer_2.quote: We analyze the performance using two key metrics. (1) Detection accuracy... we report the true positive rate (TPR) at a fixed FPR. (2) Semantic similarity: we use P-SP, a state-of-the-art paraphrase evaluation metric based on BERTScore and a human-annotated paraphrase corpus , to measure the semantic discrepancy.
